bodyText: Software Engineer, Fleet Management at Vecna Robotics. About the role: you will join a small backend team building services in Python and Go, own features end to end from design review to production, write tests, participate in code review, and take a share of the on-call rotation once ramped. What we look for: a degree in computer science or equivalent experience, comfort with SQL and one typed language, and curiosity about distributed systems. This snapshot is a SAMPLE-MODE FIXTURE authored for a course exercise; it is not a copy of a real posting.
